answers.how: The swimmer measures about 69 px from head to feet, giving 1.8/69 m/px. The pool length excluding stairs is about 387 px.
The pool width is about 182 px; multiplying by the swimmer-derived scale of 1.8/69 m/px gives 4.75 m.
A deck chair measures about 83 px lengthwise; 83 × 1.8/69 gives 2.17 m.
The swimmer moves approximately 218 px over 4.3 s. Using 1.8/69 m/px gives an average speed of 1.32 m/s.
The left umbrellas are approximately 160 px apart center-to-center; 160 × 1.8/69 gives 4.17 m.
